mj_conditioning.speaker: Michael Jordan
mj_conditioning.text: Conditioning and nutrition is very important to participating in an athletic event. Not just basketball but any other participation of an athletic event. I think you have to take it very seriously. It takes a lot of dedication and I think it may vary from player to player in terms of what I used to do. I see workout every single day. Some weights, some without weights, just aerobic exercises.

mj_stretch_sprints.speaker: Michael Jordan
mj_stretch_sprints.text: Stretching is very important. I think you should always involve stretching with your conditioning as well as with your pre workout routine. I think in terms of just getting in shape and running, I should run a lot of sprints. I should do a lot of weights that's going to improve my strength as well as my stamina. With basketball, stamina is very important.

mj_meals.speaker: Michael Jordan
mj_meals.text: You've got to eat three good meals a day. I should start off with a great breakfast, pancakes, cereal, something of that nature. Go to practice. And then work out after practice. I think it's very hard for the individual to go out and operate and demand his body to push itself.
